# GitHub Copilot Instructions for AEGIS

Read and follow repository-root `AGENTS.md` before proposing or applying code.
It is the canonical workflow for ownership, branch scope, testing, Pull
Requests, and the mandatory Obsidian task receipt.

Never push directly to `main`. Use one task branch and one Pull Request. Every
completed task must add exactly one Obsidian task receipt under
`Obsidian_AEGIS_Vault/AEGIS_Knowledge/90-Status/logs/`. Keep work in the
selected IDEA/Infrastructure area unless a shared path is technically required;
then declare every shared path and request integration review.
